Ã Ã \*\*Guest Request & Blacklist Enforcement:\*\* 

If a requested track falls under the customer's forbidden list or banned style, it is a strict "No"Ã¢ even playing "just one song" can compromise the couple's vision or set a bad precedent. 

The host/MC is empowered to politely decline by explaining that the playlist is strictly curated according to the bride and groom's precise musical guidelines. 

\*\*Exception:\*\* An exception is made only if the customer explicitly agrees in advance to play just one specific requested song to match standards, provided it is entirely appropriate (e.g., no sexual or creepy lyrics/themes). 

\# \*\*Customer Playlists & Forbidden Music Specifications\*\* 

Standardize the collection and handling of customer music preferences during the pre-event onboarding process: 

\* \*\*Must-Play & Priority Playlists:\*\* Curated list of non-negotiable tracks, key moment songs, and preferred genres/crates designated by the client. 
\* \*\*Forbidden Songs & Banned Styles:\*\* Explicit blacklist specifying prohibited individual tracks and restricted genres (e.g., disco polo, heavy metal, line dances). 

\&nbsp; 

\#\# \*\*Guest Request Protocol ("Zero Tolerance" / Blacklist Policy)\*\* 

MC and DJ operational protocol when guests submit song requests during the event: 

\* \*\*Strict Blacklist Adherence:\*\* A firm zero-compromise policy applies to all forbidden songs and restricted genres. Under no circumstances should blacklisted tracks be played. 
\* \*\*De-escalation & Polite Refusal:\*\* Staff must politely inform guests that the music selection adheres strictly to the host couple's custom blacklist and established event guidelines. 

\&nbsp;

\#\# 7.5. Venue Eating Hours & Kitchen Synchronization ("Les Repas") 

To ensure flawless coordination with the catering staff, venue manager meal schedules (\*les repas\*) must be retrieved and integrated directly into the Google Doc and wedding data cartridges. 

\#\#\# Key Rules for Eating Hours: 

\* \*\*Hours Only:\*\* The data retrieved from the venue manager should focus strictly on the scheduled \*\*hours only\*\* (e.g., starter time, main course service, hot suppers, and wedding cake hour) rather than excessive menu descriptions. 
\* \*\*Kitchen Synchronization:\*\* These meal timestamps serve as critical anchors for the Elastic Schedule Engine and drift calculations, preventing kitchen delays from colliding with hard anchors or dance blocks.

\#\# 9\\. Role-Based Access & Hosting Modes ("Host-Only" vs. "Host \\+ DJ") 

To support bookings where you are hired strictly as a Master of Ceremonies (MC) without managing the DJ's technical responsibilities or cue sheets, the application supports two distinct operational modes configurable per wedding: 

\#\#\# 9.1. Hosting Mode Configuration (hosting\\\_mode) 

\* \*\*HOST\\\_AND\\\_DJ (Default):\*\* Full real-time synchronization between your Lenovo tablet and the DJ's booth companion view. All stage pings (\\\[Drop Track\\\], \\\[Fade\\\], \\\[Hold 2m\\\]), track cutoffs, and playlist controls are fully enabled. 
\* \*\*HOST\\\_ONLY:\*\* Streamlines the Lenovo tablet interface to focus entirely on your core MC responsibilities. It completely hides all DJ-specific audio cues, track countdown timers, and remote stage pings, keeping your dashboard clean and dedicated to your script, timeline drift, cultural hard rules, and VIP alerts. 

\#\#\# 9.2. Role-Based PIN Security Architecture 

To ensure that an independent third-party DJ has zero access to your private MC scripts, sensitive family alerts, or wedding master controls when working in HOST\\\_ONLY or shared environments, the app uses split role-based PINs derived from the base wedding cartridge: 

\* \*\*Host Master PIN (sync\\\_pin\\\_host):\*\* Unlocks full administrative and performance privileges on your Lenovo tablet (and pocket remote), including trilingual scripts, dynamic drift controls, and VIP family radar. 
\* \*\*DJ Booth PIN (sync\\\_pin\\\_dj):\*\* Unlocks a restricted, read-only companion view for the DJ that displays only projected timeline steps, track titles, playlists, and hard-cutoff timers. It contains no step-advancement privileges, no access to MC teleprompters, and no visibility into confidential family notes.

\* \*\*Device 1 (Master):\*\* Lenovo Tablet (Android / Chrome PWA, Landscape Mode, Offline-First)

\#\# 1\\. Executive Summary & Product Vision 

Hosting French-Polish and international weddings requires simultaneous management of trilingual announcements (\`FR\`, \`PL\`, \`EN\`), cultural micro-traditions (\*Chleb i SÃ Â³l\*, \*Sto Lat\*, \*Gorzko Gorzko\*, \*Oczepiny\*), strict DJ audio cutoffs, kitchen synchronization, and sensitive family dynamics. Furthermore, \*\*no wedding ever runs strictly on schedule\*\*Ã¢ ceremonies run late, wishes take longer for 120 guests, or the kitchen delays a hot dish by 20 minutes. 

\*\*The Solution:\*\* A \*\*Universal Execution Engine (Multi-Device Web App)\*\* decoupled from \*\*Standardized Wedding Data Cartridges (\`.json\` files)\*\*. 

\* During preparation, messy Google Docs are converted into a clean JSON structure. 
\* On wedding day, the Lenovo tablet displays a \*\*high-contrast, dark-mode, zero-scroll dashboard\*\* where you click through each step (\`"MARK DONE & NEXT"\`), launch built-in teleprompters for speeches/games, and keep critical cultural rules pinned to the top of the screen. 
\* \*\*Dynamic Time-Drift & Elastic Schedule Engine:\*\* Tracks real-time schedule drift (\`Ã° Â¢ ON TIME\`, \`Ã° +25m LATE\`, \`Ã° Âµ -15m AHEAD\`), recalculates estimated start times for upcoming steps, uses dance blocks as shock-absorber buffers, and protects fixed deadlines (\`HARD\_ANCHOR\` events like sunset photos, videographer departure, or midnight \*Oczepiny\*). 
\* \*\*Real-Time 2-Device Cloud Sync (Option A):\*\* Using a lightweight cloud state listener (Firebase/Supabase Free Tier) and a \*\*4-digit Room PIN\*\* (e.g., \`1007\` for Ola & Eddy), your Lenovo tablet stays in \`0.2s\` real-time sync with a second device (your smartphone when hosting outdoor segments, or the DJ's screen in the booth), with automatic \`localStorage\` offline fallback if venue reception drops.

\#\# 3\\. Dynamic Time-Drift & Elastic Schedule Engine Specification 

To handle being ahead of schedule or behind schedule without breaking your flow, every timeline step is assigned one of three \*\*Time Elasticity Types\*\* (\`time\_type\`): 

| Time Type | Definition & Examples | Behavior When Late (\`+Drift\`) or Early (\`-Drift\`) | 
| :---- | :---- | :---- | 
| \*\*\`ELASTIC\`\*\* | \*\*Sequence-dependent blocks\*\* (Bread & Salt, Wishes, Dinner courses, Games, First Dance). | \*\*Shifts Automatically:\*\* If you finish step 2 at \`16:15\` instead of \`15:50\` (\`+25m\`), all subsequent \`ELASTIC\` blocks display \`Planned: 16:50 Ã¢ Â¡Ã¯Â¸ Est: 17:15\` on both the MC tablet and DJ screen. | 
| \*\*\`BUFFER\`\*\* | \*\*Accordion shock-absorbers\*\* (Musical Dance Blocks / \*Bloki muzyczne\*, Cocktail / \*Vin d'honneur\*). | \*\*Absorbs Drift:\*\* If you are \`+30m LATE\`, the app recommends shortening a 45-min dance block to 20 mins to catch up before the next hot meal or \*Oczepiny\*. If you are \`-20m AHEAD\` (guests ate quickly), the app suggests extending the dance block or pulling a \*\*Ã° Joker Game\*\* from the drawer. | 
| \*\*\`HARD\_ANCHOR\`\*\* | \*\*Unmovable real-world deadlines\*\* (\`00:00\` \*Oczepiny\*, \`00:20\` Tomek's Birthday, \`21:10\` Sunset shoot, \`21:00\` Videographer leaves, \`22:00\` Caricaturist leaves, \`01:30\` Warsaw Shuttle Bus). | \*\*Never Shifts (Triggers Compression Warning):\*\* Pinned with a lock icon (\`Ã° \`). If your cumulative drift pushes \`ELASTIC\` steps dangerously close to a \`HARD\_ANCHOR\`, an amber alert banner appears: \*"Ã¢ Ã¯Â¸ Videographer leaves at 21:00 (in 40m)\\\! Swap or Defer current game to Joker Drawer?"\* | 

\#\#\# 4 On-Stage Drift Controls (One-Tap Recovery): 

1\. \*\*Live Delta Pill (\`Ã° Â¢ ON TIME\` / \`Ã° +25m LATE\` / \`Ã° Âµ -15m AHEAD\`):\*\* Automatically calculated every time you tap \`"MARK DONE & ADVANCE"\` by comparing the step's \`planned\_time\` against the real-world clock (\`actual\_start\_time\`). 
2\. \*\*\`\[ Ã° Â½Ã¯Â¸ Kitchen / Vendor +15m \]\` Button:\*\* Adds a 15-minute manual offset to the upcoming meal or photo block and recalculates estimates for the rest of the evening (propagated immediately to the DJ's screen). 
3\. \*\*\`\[ Ã° Swap with Next \]\` Button:\*\* Instant 1-tap swap of the current block and the next block (e.g., if the kitchen isn't ready with the 19:00 Salmon or the photographer grabs the couple for a 15-minute sunset shoot, swap the game or dance block forward without losing your place). 
4\. \*\*\`\[ Ã¢ Ã¯Â¸ Defer to Joker Drawer \]\` Button:\*\* When running \`45+ mins\` behind schedule, 1 tap moves a non-essential secondary game out of the main timeline into the \*\*Joker Drawer\*\*, immediately recovering 20Ã¢ 30 minutes so you hit \`00:00 Oczepiny\` on time. You can still launch that game later from the Joker Drawer if time opens up after midnight.

\* \*\*3 Role-Specific Views on the Same Sync Channel:\*\* 
1\. \`Ã° Â¤ MC Master View (Lenovo Tablet)\`: Emphasizes trilingual scripts (\`FR\`/\`PL\`/\`EN\`), game questions, drift controls, and cultural rules.

\* \*\*Offline-First Resilience:\*\* If cellular reception drops inside a thick-walled palace or basement venue, both devices continue operating seamlessly via \`localStorage\` and automatically resync the exact second connection returns. 

\#\#\# Phase 2: Dynamic Time-Drift, Elastic Scheduling & Live Reordering (Week 3\\)

\* \*\*Live On-Stage Reordering:\*\* 1-tap \`\[Ã° Â½Ã¯Â¸ +15m\]\`, \`\[Ã° Swap with Next\]\`, and \`\[Ã¢ Ã¯Â¸ Defer to Joker Drawer\]\` buttons, plus \*\*Weather Scenario Branching\*\* (\`Ã¢ Ã¯Â¸ Sun\` / \`Ã° Â§Ã¯Â¸ Rain\` / \`Ã° Â¥ Heatwave\`) and \*\*Track Cutoff Stopwatches\*\*.

Ã BUniversal Wedding Stage Deck - Master Roadmap & Wedding Archive.md Ã Ã» \*\*Guest Request & Blacklist Enforcement:\*\* 

If a requested track falls under the customer's forbidden list or banned style, it is a strict "No"Ã¢ even playing "just one song" can compromise the couple's vision or set a bad precedent. 

The host/MC is empowered to politely decline by explaining that the playlist is strictly curated according to the bride and groom's precise musical guidelines. 

\*\*Exception:\*\* An exception is made only if the customer explicitly agrees in advance to play just one specific requested song to match standards, provided it is entirely appropriate (e.g., no sexual or creepy lyrics/themes). 

\# \*\*Customer Playlists & Forbidden Music Specifications\*\* 

Standardize the collection and handling of customer music preferences during the pre-event onboarding process: 

\* \*\*Must-Play & Priority Playlists:\*\* Curated list of non-negotiable tracks, key moment songs, and preferred genres/crates designated by the client. 
\* \*\*Forbidden Songs & Banned Styles:\*\* Explicit blacklist specifying prohibited individual tracks and restricted genres (e.g., disco polo, heavy metal, line dances). 

\&nbsp; 

\#\# \*\*Guest Request Protocol ("Zero Tolerance" / Blacklist Policy)\*\* 

MC and DJ operational protocol when guests submit song requests during the event: 

\* \*\*Strict Blacklist Adherence:\*\* A firm zero-compromise policy applies to all forbidden songs and restricted genres. Under no circumstances should blacklisted tracks be played. 
\* \*\*De-escalation & Polite Refusal:\*\* Staff must politely inform guests that the music selection adheres strictly to the host couple's custom blacklist and established event guidelines. 

\&nbsp;

\#\# 7.5. Venue Eating Hours & Kitchen Synchronization ("Les Repas") 

To ensure flawless coordination with the catering staff, venue manager meal schedules (\*les repas\*) must be retrieved and integrated directly into the Google Doc and wedding data cartridges. 

\#\#\# Key Rules for Eating Hours: 

\* \*\*Hours Only:\*\* The data retrieved from the venue manager should focus strictly on the scheduled \*\*hours only\*\* (e.g., starter time, main course service, hot suppers, and wedding cake hour) rather than excessive menu descriptions. 
\* \*\*Kitchen Synchronization:\*\* These meal timestamps serve as critical anchors for the Elastic Schedule Engine and drift calculations, preventing kitchen delays from colliding with hard anchors or dance blocks.

\#\# 9\\. Role-Based Access & Hosting Modes ("Host-Only" vs. "Host \\+ DJ") 

To support bookings where you are hired strictly as a Master of Ceremonies (MC) without managing the DJ's technical responsibilities or cue sheets, the application supports two distinct operational modes configurable per wedding: 

\#\#\# 9.1. Hosting Mode Configuration (hosting\\\_mode) 

\* \*\*HOST\\\_AND\\\_DJ (Default):\*\* Full real-time synchronization between your Lenovo tablet and the DJ's booth companion view. All stage pings (\\\[Drop Track\\\], \\\[Fade\\\], \\\[Hold 2m\\\]), track cutoffs, and playlist controls are fully enabled. 
\* \*\*HOST\\\_ONLY:\*\* Streamlines the Lenovo tablet interface to focus entirely on your core MC responsibilities. It completely hides all DJ-specific audio cues, track countdown timers, and remote stage pings, keeping your dashboard clean and dedicated to your script, timeline drift, cultural hard rules, and VIP alerts. 

\#\#\# 9.2. Role-Based PIN Security Architecture 

To ensure that an independent third-party DJ has zero access to your private MC scripts, sensitive family alerts, or wedding master controls when working in HOST\\\_ONLY or shared environments, the app uses split role-based PINs derived from the base wedding cartridge: 

\* \*\*Host Master PIN (sync\\\_pin\\\_host):\*\* Unlocks full administrative and performance privileges on your Lenovo tablet (and pocket remote), including trilingual scripts, dynamic drift controls, and VIP family radar. 
\* \*\*DJ Booth PIN (sync\\\_pin\\\_dj):\*\* Unlocks a restricted, read-only companion view for the DJ that displays only projected timeline steps, track titles, playlists, and hard-cutoff timers. It contains no step-advancement privileges, no access to MC teleprompters, and no visibility into confidential family notes.

\#\# 1\\. Executive Summary & Product Vision 

Hosting French-Polish and international weddings requires simultaneous management of trilingual announcements (\`FR\`, \`PL\`, \`EN\`), cultural micro-traditions (\*Chleb i SÃ Â³l\*, \*Sto Lat\*, \*Gorzko Gorzko\*, \*Oczepiny\*), strict DJ audio cutoffs, kitchen synchronization, and sensitive family dynamics. Furthermore, \*\*no wedding ever runs strictly on schedule\*\*Ã¢ ceremonies run late, wishes take longer for 120 guests, or the kitchen delays a hot dish by 20 minutes. 

\*\*The Solution:\*\* A \*\*Universal Execution Engine (Multi-Device Web App)\*\* decoupled from \*\*Standardized Wedding Data Cartridges (\`.json\` files)\*\*. 

\* During preparation, messy Google Docs are converted into a clean JSON structure. 
\* On wedding day, the Lenovo tablet displays a \*\*high-contrast, dark-mode, zero-scroll dashboard\*\* where you click through each step (\`"MARK DONE & NEXT"\`), launch built-in teleprompters for speeches/games, and keep critical cultural rules pinned to the top of the screen. 
\* \*\*Dynamic Time-Drift & Elastic Schedule Engine:\*\* Tracks real-time schedule drift (\`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Â¢ ON TIME\`, \`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã +25m LATE\`, \`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Âµ -15m AHEAD\`), recalculates estimated start times for upcoming steps, uses dance blocks as shock-absorber buffers, and protects fixed deadlines (\`HARD\_ANCHOR\` events like sunset photos, videographer departure, or midnight \*Oczepiny\*). 
\* \*\*Real-Time 2-Device Cloud Sync (Option A):\*\* Using a lightweight cloud state listener (Firebase/Supabase Free Tier) and a \*\*4-digit Room PIN\*\* (e.g., \`1007\` for Ola & Eddy), your Lenovo tablet stays in \`0.2s\` real-time sync with a second device (your smartphone when hosting outdoor segments, or the DJ's screen in the booth), with automatic \`localStorage\` offline fallback if venue reception drops.

\#\# 3\\. Dynamic Time-Drift & Elastic Schedule Engine Specification 

To handle being ahead of schedule or behind schedule without breaking your flow, every timeline step is assigned one of three \*\*Time Elasticity Types\*\* (\`time\_type\`): 

| Time Type | Definition & Examples | Behavior When Late (\`+Drift\`) or Early (\`-Drift\`) | 
| :---- | :---- | :---- | 
| \*\*\`ELASTIC\`\*\* | \*\*Sequence-dependent blocks\*\* (Bread & Salt, Wishes, Dinner courses, Games, First Dance). | \*\*Shifts Automatically:\*\* If you finish step 2 at \`16:15\` instead of \`15:50\` (\`+25m\`), all subsequent \`ELASTIC\` blocks display \`Planned: 16:50 Ã¢ Â¡Ã¯Â¸ Est: 17:15\` on both the MC tablet and DJ screen. | 
| \*\*\`BUFFER\`\*\* | \*\*Accordion shock-absorbers\*\* (Musical Dance Blocks / \*Bloki muzyczne\*, Cocktail / \*Vin d'honneur\*). | \*\*Absorbs Drift:\*\* If you are \`+30m LATE\`, the app recommends shortening a 45-min dance block to 20 mins to catch up before the next hot meal or \*Oczepiny\*. If you are \`-20m AHEAD\` (guests ate quickly), the app suggests extending the dance block or pulling a \*\*Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Joker Game\*\* from the drawer. | 
| \*\*\`HARD\_ANCHOR\`\*\* | \*\*Unmovable real-world deadlines\*\* (\`00:00\` \*Oczepiny\*, \`00:20\` Tomek's Birthday, \`21:10\` Sunset shoot, \`21:00\` Videographer leaves, \`22:00\` Caricaturist leaves, \`01:30\` Warsaw Shuttle Bus). | \*\*Never Shifts (Triggers Compression Warning):\*\* Pinned with a lock icon (\`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã \`). If your cumulative drift pushes \`ELASTIC\` steps dangerously close to a \`HARD\_ANCHOR\`, an amber alert banner appears: \*"Ã¢ Ã¯Â¸ Videographer leaves at 21:00 (in 40m)\\\! Swap or Defer current game to Joker Drawer?"\* | 

\#\#\# 4 On-Stage Drift Controls (One-Tap Recovery): 

1\. \*\*Live Delta Pill (\`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Â¢ ON TIME\` / \`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã +25m LATE\` / \`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Âµ -15m AHEAD\`):\*\* Automatically calculated every time you tap \`"MARK DONE & ADVANCE"\` by comparing the step's \`planned\_time\` against the real-world clock (\`actual\_start\_time\`). 
2\. \*\*\`\[ Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Â½Ã¯Â¸ Kitchen / Vendor +15m \]\` Button:\*\* Adds a 15-minute manual offset to the upcoming meal or photo block and recalculates estimates for the rest of the evening (propagated immediately to the DJ's screen). 
3\. \*\*\`\[ Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Swap with Next \]\` Button:\*\* Instant 1-tap swap of the current block and the next block (e.g., if the kitchen isn't ready with the 19:00 Salmon or the photographer grabs the couple for a 15-minute sunset shoot, swap the game or dance block forward without losing your place). 
4\. \*\*\`\[ Ã¢ Ã¯Â¸ Defer to Joker Drawer \]\` Button:\*\* When running \`45+ mins\` behind schedule, 1 tap moves a non-essential secondary game out of the main timeline into the \*\*Joker Drawer\*\*, immediately recovering 20Ã¢ 30 minutes so you hit \`00:00 Oczepiny\` on time. You can still launch that game later from the Joker Drawer if time opens up after midnight.

\* \*\*Instant State Propagation (\`\<0.2s\`):\*\* Tapping \`"MARK DONE & ADVANCE"\`, adjusting time drift (\`+15m\`), or swapping steps on Device 1 (Lenovo Tablet) pushes a tiny \`\<1 KB\` JSON state payload to the cloud, immediately updating Device 2\\. 
\* \*\*3 Role-Specific Views on the Same Sync Channel:\*\* 
1\. \`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Â¤ MC Master View (Lenovo Tablet)\`: Emphasizes trilingual scripts (\`FR\`/\`PL\`/\`EN\`), game questions, drift controls, and cultural rules. 
2\. \`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Â§ DJ Booth View (DJ's Laptop/Phone)\`: Highlights playlist names, track titles, \*\*projected real start times\*\*, and flashing red hard-cutoff timers (e.g., \*YamÃ Âª @ 1:05\*, \*Skales @ 2:10\*). 
3\. \`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Â± Pocket Remote View (Your Smartphone)\`: Compact vertical view for when you walk out to the garden for \*Aperitif\*, \*Ceremony\*, or \*Outdoor Cake\*, letting you advance steps and check time drift from your hand. 
\* \*\*Silent Stage Ping Buttons:\*\* 1-tap silent communication buttons (\`"Ã¢ Â¶Ã¯Â¸ Drop Track"\`, \`"Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Fade Music"\`, \`"Ã¢ Â³ Hold 2 Mins"\`, \`"Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Â¤ Ready for Entrance"\`) that flash a high-visibility banner on the second screen across a noisy room. 
\* \*\*Offline-First Resilience:\*\* If cellular reception drops inside a thick-walled palace or basement venue, both devices continue operating seamlessly via \`localStorage\` and automatically resync the exact second connection returns.

\* \*\*\`HARD\_ANCHOR\` Collision Warnings:\*\* Monitors fixed deadlines (vendor departures, sunset times, midnight \*Oczepiny\*, shuttle buses) and warns you 45 minutes prior if current drift threatens a collision. 
\* \*\*Live On-Stage Reordering:\*\* 1-tap \`\[Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Â½Ã¯Â¸ +15m\]\`, \`\[Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Swap with Next\]\`, and \`\[Ã¢ Ã¯Â¸ Defer to Joker Drawer\]\` buttons, plus \*\*Weather Scenario Branching\*\* (\`Ã¢ Ã¯Â¸ Sun\` / \`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Â§Ã¯Â¸ Rain\` / \`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Â¥ Heatwave\`) and \*\*Track Cutoff Stopwatches\*\*.

Standardize the collection and handling of customer music preferences during the pre-event onboarding process:

\#\# 7.5. Venue Eating Hours & Kitchen Synchronization ("Les Repas") 

To ensure flawless coordination with the catering staff, venue manager meal schedules (\*les repas\*) must be retrieved and integrated directly into the Google Doc and wedding data cartridges.

\* \*\*Hours Only:\*\* The data retrieved from the venue manager should focus strictly on the scheduled \*\*hours only\*\* (e.g., starter time, main course service, hot suppers, and wedding cake hour) rather than excessive menu descriptions.

\#\# 9\\. Role-Based Access & Hosting Modes ("Host-Only" vs. "Host \\+ DJ") 

To support bookings where you are hired strictly as a Master of Ceremonies (MC) without managing the DJ's technical responsibilities or cue sheets, the application supports two distinct operational modes configurable per wedding: 

\#\#\# 9.1. Hosting Mode Configuration (hosting\\\_mode) 

\* \*\*HOST\\\_AND\\\_DJ (Default):\*\* Full real-time synchronization between your Lenovo tablet and the DJ's booth companion view. All stage pings (\\\[Drop Track\\\], \\\[Fade\\\], \\\[Hold 2m\\\]), track cutoffs, and playlist controls are fully enabled. 
\* \*\*HOST\\\_ONLY:\*\* Streamlines the Lenovo tablet interface to focus entirely on your core MC responsibilities. It completely hides all DJ-specific audio cues, track countdown timers, and remote stage pings, keeping your dashboard clean and dedicated to your script, timeline drift, cultural hard rules, and VIP alerts. 

\#\#\# 9.2. Role-Based PIN Security Architecture 

To ensure that an independent third-party DJ has zero access to your private MC scripts, sensitive family alerts, or wedding master controls when working in HOST\\\_ONLY or shared environments, the app uses split role-based PINs derived from the base wedding cartridge: 

\* \*\*Host Master PIN (sync\\\_pin\\\_host):\*\* Unlocks full administrative and performance privileges on your Lenovo tablet (and pocket remote), including trilingual scripts, dynamic drift controls, and VIP family radar. 
\* \*\*DJ Booth PIN (sync\\\_pin\\\_dj):\*\* Unlocks a restricted, read-only companion view for the DJ that displays only projected timeline steps, track titles, playlists, and hard-cutoff timers. It contains no step-advancement privileges, no access to MC teleprompters, and no visibility into confidential family notes.

\#\# 1\\. Executive Summary & Product Vision 

Hosting French-Polish and international weddings requires simultaneous management of trilingual announcements (\`FR\`, \`PL\`, \`EN\`), cultural micro-traditions (\*Chleb i SÃ Â³l\*, \*Sto Lat\*, \*Gorzko Gorzko\*, \*Oczepiny\*), strict DJ audio cutoffs, kitchen synchronization, and sensitive family dynamics. Furthermore, \*\*no wedding ever runs strictly on schedule\*\*Ã¢ ceremonies run late, wishes take longer for 120 guests, or the kitchen delays a hot dish by 20 minutes. 

\*\*The Solution:\*\* A \*\*Universal Execution Engine (Multi-Device Web App)\*\* decoupled from \*\*Standardized Wedding Data Cartridges (\`.json\` files)\*\*. 

\* During preparation, messy Google Docs are converted into a clean JSON structure. 
\* On wedding day, the Lenovo tablet displays a \*\*high-contrast, dark-mode, zero-scroll dashboard\*\* where you click through each step (\`"MARK DONE & NEXT"\`), launch built-in teleprompters for speeches/games, and keep critical cultural rules pinned to the top of the screen. 
\* \*\*Dynamic Time-Drift & Elastic Schedule Engine:\*\* Tracks real-time schedule drift (\`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Â¢ ON TIME\`, \`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã +25m LATE\`, \`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Âµ -15m AHEAD\`), recalculates estimated start times for upcoming steps, uses dance blocks as shock-absorber buffers, and protects fixed deadlines (\`HARD\_ANCHOR\` events like sunset photos, videographer departure, or midnight \*Oczepiny\*). 
\* \*\*Real-Time 2-Device Cloud Sync (Option A):\*\* Using a lightweight cloud state listener (Firebase/Supabase Free Tier) and a \*\*4-digit Room PIN\*\* (e.g., \`1007\` for Ola & Eddy), your Lenovo tablet stays in \`0.2s\` real-time sync with a second device (your smartphone when hosting outdoor segments, or the DJ's screen in the booth), with automatic \`localStorage\` offline fallback if venue reception drops.

\#\# 3\\. Dynamic Time-Drift & Elastic Schedule Engine Specification 

To handle being ahead of schedule or behind schedule without breaking your flow, every timeline step is assigned one of three \*\*Time Elasticity Types\*\* (\`time\_type\`): 

| Time Type | Definition & Examples | Behavior When Late (\`+Drift\`) or Early (\`-Drift\`) | 
| :---- | :---- | :---- | 
| \*\*\`ELASTIC\`\*\* | \*\*Sequence-dependent blocks\*\* (Bread & Salt, Wishes, Dinner courses, Games, First Dance). | \*\*Shifts Automatically:\*\* If you finish step 2 at \`16:15\` instead of \`15:50\` (\`+25m\`), all subsequent \`ELASTIC\` blocks display \`Planned: 16:50 Ã¢ Â¡Ã¯Â¸ Est: 17:15\` on both the MC tablet and DJ screen. | 
| \*\*\`BUFFER\`\*\* | \*\*Accordion shock-absorbers\*\* (Musical Dance Blocks / \*Bloki muzyczne\*, Cocktail / \*Vin d'honneur\*). | \*\*Absorbs Drift:\*\* If you are \`+30m LATE\`, the app recommends shortening a 45-min dance block to 20 mins to catch up before the next hot meal or \*Oczepiny\*. If you are \`-20m AHEAD\` (guests ate quickly), the app suggests extending the dance block or pulling a \*\*Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Joker Game\*\* from the drawer. | 
| \*\*\`HARD\_ANCHOR\`\*\* | \*\*Unmovable real-world deadlines\*\* (\`00:00\` \*Oczepiny\*, \`00:20\` Tomek's Birthday, \`21:10\` Sunset shoot, \`21:00\` Videographer leaves, \`22:00\` Caricaturist leaves, \`01:30\` Warsaw Shuttle Bus). | \*\*Never Shifts (Triggers Compression Warning):\*\* Pinned with a lock icon (\`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã \`). If your cumulative drift pushes \`ELASTIC\` steps dangerously close to a \`HARD\_ANCHOR\`, an amber alert banner appears: \*"Ã¢ Ã¯Â¸ Videographer leaves at 21:00 (in 40m)\\\! Swap or Defer current game to Joker Drawer?"\* | 

\#\#\# 4 On-Stage Drift Controls (One-Tap Recovery): 

1\. \*\*Live Delta Pill (\`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Â¢ ON TIME\` / \`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã +25m LATE\` / \`Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Âµ -15m AHEAD\`):\*\* Automatically calculated every time you tap \`"MARK DONE & ADVANCE"\` by comparing the step's \`planned\_time\` against the real-world clock (\`actual\_start\_time\`). 
2\. \*\*\`\[ Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Â½Ã¯Â¸ Kitchen / Vendor +15m \]\` Button:\*\* Adds a 15-minute manual offset to the upcoming meal or photo block and recalculates estimates for the rest of the evening (propagated immediately to the DJ's screen). 
3\. \*\*\`\[ Ã Â°Ã Ã Ã Swap with Next \]\` Button:\*\* Instant 1-tap swap of the current block and the next block (e.g., if the kitchen isn't ready with the 19:00 Salmon or the photographer grabs the couple for a 15-minute sunset shoot, swap the game or dance block forward without losing your place). 
4\. \*\*\`\[ Ã¢ Ã¯Â¸ Defer to Joker Drawer \]\` Button:\*\* When running \`45+ mins\` behind schedule, 1 tap moves a non-essential secondary game out of the main timeline into the \*\*Joker Drawer\*\*, immediately recovering 20Ã¢ 30 minutes so you hit \`00:00 Oczepiny\` on time. You can still launch that game later from the Joker Drawer if time opens up after midnight.

Ã Ã **Guest Request & Blacklist Enforcement:**

If a requested track falls under the customer's forbidden list or banned style, it is a strict "No"Ã¢ even playing "just one song" can compromise the couple's vision or set a bad precedent.

The host/MC is empowered to politely decline by explaining that the playlist is strictly curated according to the bride and groom's precise musical guidelines.

**Exception:** An exception is made only if the customer explicitly agrees in advance to play just one specific requested song to match standards, provided it is entirely appropriate (e.g., no sexual or creepy lyrics/themes).

# **Customer Playlists & Forbidden Music Specifications**

Standardize the collection and handling of customer music preferences during the pre-event onboarding process:

* **Must-Play & Priority Playlists:** Curated list of non-negotiable tracks, key moment songs, and preferred genres/crates designated by the client. 
* **Forbidden Songs & Banned Styles:** Explicit blacklist specifying prohibited individual tracks and restricted genres (e.g., disco polo, heavy metal, line dances).

&nbsp;

## **Guest Request Protocol ("Zero Tolerance" / Blacklist Policy)**

MC and DJ operational protocol when guests submit song requests during the event:

* **Strict Blacklist Adherence:** A firm zero-compromise policy applies to all forbidden songs and restricted genres. Under no circumstances should blacklisted tracks be played. 
* **De-escalation & Polite Refusal:** Staff must politely inform guests that the music selection adheres strictly to the host couple's custom blacklist and established event guidelines.

## 7.5. Venue Eating Hours & Kitchen Synchronization ("Les Repas")

To ensure flawless coordination with the catering staff, venue manager meal schedules (*les repas*) must be retrieved and integrated directly into the Google Doc and wedding data cartridges.

### Key Rules for Eating Hours:

* **Hours Only:** The data retrieved from the venue manager should focus strictly on the scheduled **hours only** (e.g., starter time, main course service, hot suppers, and wedding cake hour) rather than excessive menu descriptions. 
* **Kitchen Synchronization:** These meal timestamps serve as critical anchors for the Elastic Schedule Engine and drift calculations, preventing kitchen delays from colliding with hard anchors or dance blocks.

## 9\. Role-Based Access & Hosting Modes ("Host-Only" vs. "Host \+ DJ")

To support bookings where you are hired strictly as a Master of Ceremonies (MC) without managing the DJ's technical responsibilities or cue sheets, the application supports two distinct operational modes configurable per wedding:

### 9.1. Hosting Mode Configuration (hosting\_mode)

* **HOST\_AND\_DJ (Default):** Full real-time synchronization between your Lenovo tablet and the DJ's booth companion view. All stage pings (\[Drop Track\], \[Fade\], \[Hold 2m\]), track cutoffs, and playlist controls are fully enabled. 
* **HOST\_ONLY:** Streamlines the Lenovo tablet interface to focus entirely on your core MC responsibilities. It completely hides all DJ-specific audio cues, track countdown timers, and remote stage pings, keeping your dashboard clean and dedicated to your script, timeline drift, cultural hard rules, and VIP alerts.

### 9.2. Role-Based PIN Security Architecture

To ensure that an independent third-party DJ has zero access to your private MC scripts, sensitive family alerts, or wedding master controls when working in HOST\_ONLY or shared environments, the app uses split role-based PINs derived from the base wedding cartridge:

* **Host Master PIN (sync\_pin\_host):** Unlocks full administrative and performance privileges on your Lenovo tablet (and pocket remote), including trilingual scripts, dynamic drift controls, and VIP family radar. 
* **DJ Booth PIN (sync\_pin\_dj):** Unlocks a restricted, read-only companion view for the DJ that displays only projected timeline steps, track titles, playlists, and hard-cutoff timers. It contains no step-advancement privileges, no access to MC teleprompters, and no visibility into confidential family notes.

## 1\. Executive Summary & Product Vision

Hosting French-Polish and international weddings requires simultaneous management of trilingual announcements (`FR`, `PL`, `EN`), cultural micro-traditions (*Chleb i SÃ Â³l*, *Sto Lat*, *Gorzko Gorzko*, *Oczepiny*), strict DJ audio cutoffs, kitchen synchronization, and sensitive family dynamics. Furthermore, **no wedding ever runs strictly on schedule**Ã¢ ceremonies run late, wishes take longer for 120 guests, or the kitchen delays a hot dish by 20 minutes.

**The Solution:** A **Universal Execution Engine (Multi-Device Web App)** decoupled from **Standardized Wedding Data Cartridges (`.json` files)**.

* During preparation, messy Google Docs are converted into a clean JSON structure. 
* On wedding day, the Lenovo tablet displays a **high-contrast, dark-mode, zero-scroll dashboard** where you click through each step (`"MARK DONE & NEXT"`), launch built-in teleprompters for speeches/games, and keep critical cultural rules pinned to the top of the screen. 
* **Dynamic Time-Drift & Elastic Schedule Engine:** Tracks real-time schedule drift (`Ã° Â¢ ON TIME`, `Ã° +25m LATE`, `Ã° Âµ -15m AHEAD`), recalculates estimated start times for upcoming steps, uses dance blocks as shock-absorber buffers, and protects fixed deadlines (`HARD_ANCHOR` events like sunset photos, videographer departure, or midnight *Oczepiny*). 
* **Real-Time 2-Device Cloud Sync (Option A):** Using a lightweight cloud state listener (Firebase/Supabase Free Tier) and a **4-digit Room PIN** (e.g., `1007` for Ola & Eddy), your Lenovo tablet stays in `0.2s` real-time sync with a second device (your smartphone when hosting outdoor segments, or the DJ's screen in the booth), with automatic `localStorage` offline fallback if venue reception drops.

## 3\. Dynamic Time-Drift & Elastic Schedule Engine Specification

To handle being ahead of schedule or behind schedule without breaking your flow, every timeline step is assigned one of three **Time Elasticity Types** (`time_type`):

| Time Type | Definition & Examples | Behavior When Late (`+Drift`) or Early (`-Drift`) |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **`ELASTIC`** | **Sequence-dependent blocks** (Bread & Salt, Wishes, Dinner courses, Games, First Dance). | **Shifts Automatically:** If you finish step 2 at `16:15` instead of `15:50` (`+25m`), all subsequent `ELASTIC` blocks display `Planned: 16:50 Ã¢ Â¡Ã¯Â¸ Est: 17:15` on both the MC tablet and DJ screen. |
| **`BUFFER`** | **Accordion shock-absorbers** (Musical Dance Blocks / *Bloki muzyczne*, Cocktail / *Vin d'honneur*). | **Absorbs Drift:** If you are `+30m LATE`, the app recommends shortening a 45-min dance block to 20 mins to catch up before the next hot meal or *Oczepiny*. If you are `-20m AHEAD` (guests ate quickly), the app suggests extending the dance block or pulling a **Ã° Joker Game** from the drawer. |
| **`HARD_ANCHOR`** | **Unmovable real-world deadlines** (`00:00` *Oczepiny*, `00:20` Tomek's Birthday, `21:10` Sunset shoot, `21:00` Videographer leaves, `22:00` Caricaturist leaves, `01:30` Warsaw Shuttle Bus). | **Never Shifts (Triggers Compression Warning):** Pinned with a lock icon (`Ã° `). If your cumulative drift pushes `ELASTIC` steps dangerously close to a `HARD_ANCHOR`, an amber alert banner appears: *"Ã¢ Ã¯Â¸ Videographer leaves at 21:00 (in 40m)\! Swap or Defer current game to Joker Drawer?"* |

### 4 On-Stage Drift Controls (One-Tap Recovery):

1. **Live Delta Pill (`Ã° Â¢ ON TIME` / `Ã° +25m LATE` / `Ã° Âµ -15m AHEAD`):** Automatically calculated every time you tap `"MARK DONE & ADVANCE"` by comparing the step's `planned_time` against the real-world clock (`actual_start_time`). 
2. **`[ Ã° Â½Ã¯Â¸ Kitchen / Vendor +15m ]` Button:** Adds a 15-minute manual offset to the upcoming meal or photo block and recalculates estimates for the rest of the evening (propagated immediately to the DJ's screen). 
3. **`[ Ã° Swap with Next ]` Button:** Instant 1-tap swap of the current block and the next block (e.g., if the kitchen isn't ready with the 19:00 Salmon or the photographer grabs the couple for a 15-minute sunset shoot, swap the game or dance block forward without losing your place). 
4. **`[ Ã¢ Ã¯Â¸ Defer to Joker Drawer ]` Button:** When running `45+ mins` behind schedule, 1 tap moves a non-essential secondary game out of the main timeline into the **Joker Drawer**, immediately recovering 20Ã¢ 30 minutes so you hit `00:00 Oczepiny` on time. You can still launch that game later from the Joker Drawer if time opens up after midnight.

## 4\. Product Roadmap (Iterative Phases)

### Phase 1: MVP Ã¢ The Universal Stage Deck Engine (Weeks 1Ã¢ 2)

* **Deliverable:** Single-file Offline-First HTML5/React Tablet Application. 
* **Core Features:** 
* **Cultural Hard-Rules Bar:** Persistent top badges showing `STO LAT` (Yes \+ FR Explain / STRICT NO), `GORZKO` (Yes / Guest-initiated only / STRICT NO), and `BREAD & SALT` rules. 
* **Step-by-Step State Machine:** Large `"MARK DONE & ADVANCE"` button with `Undo` support and `localStorage` persistence (survives tablet lock or browser refresh). 
* **Sub-Task Checkboxes:** Tick off micro-events inside a block (e.g., *1\. Bouquet toss \-\> 2\. Bowtie toss \-\> 3\. Winner photos*). 
* **Built-in Teleprompter & Game Clicker:** Full-screen overlay for reading trilingual ceremonies (*Justyna & Antoine*) or clicking through 14 *Test Wiedzy* questions one by one. 
* **VIP & Tactful Alerts Modal:** One-tap red button for sensitive family notes (*Uncle Sylwek's guitar limit*, *Uncle Dawid alert*, *Guest birthdays*, *Blind grandmother*).

### Phase 1.5: 2-Device Cloud Real-Time Sync Ã¢ Option A (Week 2.5)

* **Deliverable:** Cloud Real-Time State Synchronization (Firebase / Supabase Free Tier) \+ Role Switcher. 
* **Core Features (Option A Architecture):** 
* **4-Digit Room PIN Pairing:** Both devices open the web app URL and enter the wedding's 4-digit PIN (e.g., `1007` for Ola & Eddy, `2008` for Jennifer & Guillaume). Zero complex setup; works over any 4G/5G mobile hotspot. 
* **Instant State Propagation (`<0.2s`):** Tapping `"MARK DONE & ADVANCE"`, adjusting time drift (`+15m`), or swapping steps on Device 1 (Lenovo Tablet) pushes a tiny `<1 KB` JSON state payload to the cloud, immediately updating Device 2\. 
* **3 Role-Specific Views on the Same Sync Channel:** 
1. `Ã° Â¤ MC Master View (Lenovo Tablet)`: Emphasizes trilingual scripts (`FR`/`PL`/`EN`), game questions, drift controls, and cultural rules. 
2. `Ã° Â§ DJ Booth View (DJ's Laptop/Phone)`: Highlights playlist names, track titles, **projected real start times**, and flashing red hard-cutoff timers (e.g., *YamÃ Âª @ 1:05*, *Skales @ 2:10*). 
3. `Ã° Â± Pocket Remote View (Your Smartphone)`: Compact vertical view for when you walk out to the garden for *Aperitif*, *Ceremony*, or *Outdoor Cake*, letting you advance steps and check time drift from your hand. 
* **Silent Stage Ping Buttons:** 1-tap silent communication buttons (`"Ã¢ Â¶Ã¯Â¸ Drop Track"`, `"Ã° Fade Music"`, `"Ã¢ Â³ Hold 2 Mins"`, `"Ã° Â¤ Ready for Entrance"`) that flash a high-visibility banner on the second screen across a noisy room. 
* **Offline-First Resilience:** If cellular reception drops inside a thick-walled palace or basement venue, both devices continue operating seamlessly via `localStorage` and automatically resync the exact second connection returns.

### Phase 2: Dynamic Time-Drift, Elastic Scheduling & Live Reordering (Week 3\)

* **Deliverable:** Real-Time Drift Calculator, `HARD_ANCHOR` Protection Radar, and 1-Tap On-Stage Schedule Mutation. 
* **Core Features:** 
* **Automatic Drift Calculation:** Logs `actual_start_time` on every step transition, computes the live `drift_minutes` delta (`+Late` / `-Ahead`), and projects realistic timestamps for all upcoming `ELASTIC` blocks. 
* **`BUFFER` Accordion Logic:** Automatically calculates how much time can be shaved off upcoming dance blocks when running behind, or prompts to pull a **Ã° Joker Game** when running ahead of the kitchen. 
* **`HARD_ANCHOR` Collision Warnings:** Monitors fixed deadlines (vendor departures, sunset times, midnight *Oczepiny*, shuttle buses) and warns you 45 minutes prior if current drift threatens a collision. 
* **Live On-Stage Reordering:** 1-tap `[Ã° Â½Ã¯Â¸ +15m]`, `[Ã° Swap with Next]`, and `[Ã¢ Ã¯Â¸ Defer to Joker Drawer]` buttons, plus **Weather Scenario Branching** (`Ã¢ Ã¯Â¸ Sun` / `Ã° Â§Ã¯Â¸ Rain` / `Ã° Â¥ Heatwave`) and **Track Cutoff Stopwatches**.

### Phase 3: The "Raw Notes to JSON" AI Ingestion Pipeline (Week 4\)

* **Deliverable:** Standardized Converter Prompt \+ In-App JSON Importer. 
* **Core Features:** 
* Copy-paste any raw Google Doc harmonogram into an AI prompt (or in-app text box) to automatically output a validated `WeddingSchema v1.1` JSON cartridge (complete with `ELASTIC`, `BUFFER`, and `HARD_ANCHOR` classifications). 
* **Pre-Flight Action Extractor:** Automatically pulls pre-wedding tasks (e.g., *"Call DJ Karol 1 week before"*, *"Check XLR cables at 16:15"*, *"Confirm Test ZgodnoÃ ci with witness Bartek"*) into a Pre-Wedding Checklist tab.

## 7\. AI Converter Prompt (For Future Weddings)

When you receive a new Google Doc from a couple in the future, paste this prompt along with their raw notes:

> **Prompt:** "Act as my Wedding Stage Deck Data Engineer. Convert the following raw French-Polish wedding notes into a valid `WeddingSchema v1.1` JSON object (including a 4-digit `sync_pin` based on the wedding date `DDMM`). Extract all cultural rules (`Sto Lat`, `Gorzko Gorzko`, `Bread & Salt`), VIP/tactful family warnings, vendor contacts, audio track cutoffs (in seconds), weather branches, and chronological steps with separate `FR`, `PL`, and `EN` MC cues, DJ cues, catering notes, and sub-task checkboxes. Classify every step's `time_type` as `ELASTIC`, `BUFFER` (dance/cocktail blocks), or `HARD_ANCHOR` (fixed deadlines like vendor departures, sunset, midnight Oczepiny, or shuttle buses)."

### 11. Co-Hosting & Wedding Content Creator Module (Extension)
* **Co-Hosts / Ceremony Drivers:** Support for assigning co-hosts (e.g., Zuzia & Val) to assist in driving ceremonies or welcoming guests in multiple languages alongside the MC.
* **Wedding Content Creator:** Dedicated vendor tracking for social media content creators (e.g., capturing behind-the-scenes moments, reels, and stories without interfering with the official photographer/videographer).
* **Family Dynamic / Divorce Warning Flag:** Optional alert tag for divorced parents (e.g., groom's parents divorced and estranged) to ensure smooth, stress-free staging during the Bread & Salt or entrance greetings.
* **Advice Notes / Extra Wishes:** Provision for guests to write personal advice notes on separate slips independently of the main guestbook.

## 10. Automated Deployments & CI/CD Pipeline (GitLab Integration)

To streamline releasing updates to your Universal Wedding Stage Deck and keep your PWA offline-first assets always up to date across your devices, **GitLab CI/CD** is integrated directly into the repository workflow.

### 10.1. Why GitLab CI/CD Fits This Project
* **Built-In Runners & Zero Configuration:** GitLab includes native CI/CD pipelines out-of-the-box without requiring external plugins or third-party marketplaces.
* **Unified Workspace:** Source code, version control, issue boards, and deployment pipelines live under a single roof.

### 10.2. The GitLab CI/CD Pipeline Structure (`.gitlab-ci.yml`)
The automated pipeline executes three distinct stages on every push to the `main` branch:
1. **`build` stage:** Installs project dependencies (Node.js/Vite) and compiles the React PWA into optimized production static assets.
2. **`test` stage:** Runs automated linting and cartridge schema validation tests (`WeddingSchema v1.1`) to ensure JSON files and scripts are error-free.
3. **`deploy` stage:** Automatically publishes the compiled build artifacts to your hosting target (e.g., GitLab Pages, Vercel, or Netlify) via secure deployment tokens.

### 10.3. Example `.gitlab-ci.yml` Configuration File
```yaml
stages:
  - build
  - test
  - deploy

cache:
  paths:
    - node_modules/

build_app:
  stage: build
  image: node:18-alpine
  script:
    - npm install
    - npm run build
  artifacts:
    paths:
      - dist/

test_schemas:
  stage: test
  image: node:18-alpine
  script:
    - npm test

deploy_pages:
  stage: deploy
  image: alpine:latest
  script:
    - echo "Deploying Universal Wedding Stage Deck PWA..."
  environment:
    name: production
    url: https://your-domain.gitlab.io/stage-deck
  only:
    - main
```
